verdict.rationale: The docs show that verification results can be retrieved programmatically via webhook or polling. Webhooks report workflow status changes, and several report types act as risk signals: document authenticity, facial similarity, watchlist screening, and known-faces repeat-fraud detection. However, nothing in the pack documents the structured result schema itself, such as result or sub-result values, per-check breakdowns, or failure-reason codes an agent could branch on. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable result fields and outcome values, explicit failure/rejection reason codes, risk scores or breakdown structure, and hands-on corroboration of agent branching on results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on
